title: The boss lab's long browser steps are flaky on this loaded machine: --boss-bait's keep and speed bands, --boss-fight's 15 s Bofors loss; one --boss-wave failure was a stale-aim test bug
context: Runs on kainode under a WARN memory guardrail (swap 4-5 GB pinned), one headless Chrome, 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-11.
outcome: --boss-bait's keep-distance median (17-23 m) and arena speed band failed 6 of 14 runs after Isao's finite acceleration (0ad1eafb), 0 of 6 before; the owner's call whether to widen them, raise accel or accept. --boss-fight loses the circling tank to a seed-1 Bofors round at 15.03 s on some runs (tank mode, older than the bait mode). --boss-wave's Reed-carcass 40 mm check failed from a0529f83 until 34a7533e: it aimed at the carcass tip's local point recorded once, but the lab's local plane follows the walking boss and re-anchors (the tip's local point moved tens of metres in seconds); fixed in the test, the carcass code was right. Lesson: in the boss lab, re-read a world-fixed thing's local point before every use; local points go stale within seconds.
